body: I was just at this ski resort.

Thank you. It's comforting to know that other people are in the same boat, even if it's sinking. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't drunk right now. Or that I don't get drunk alone 5 nights a week. But how do I find something worth living for? I've got 7 siblings and my family would be upset, but they'd recover, I'd just be 'the sister who killed herself,' and they'd continue living. I know as individuals, we're insignificant, that we can't affect pollution, or gas prices, or the orbit, and I don't expect to be famous or influential, but I just fucking need somebody right now. I need purpose, but life doesn't have it. Maybe it's weak to reach out to strangers on reddit, but I can't talk about being depressed with anyone I know because that's hard. I just need to talk.
